system.description:
Secret (a moonstone carving).

Study: someone who carries lycanthropy; 8 weeks, DC 15, a Wisdom check.

Teaches: mastery of the curse.

  • You change only when you choose, as part of your action, and keep your mind in every form; your bite passes the curse only if you wish.
  • In hybrid or animal form you use your lycanthrope block's natural attacks with your own attributes and BtH, and you have Resistance 5 against non-magical, non-silvered weapons.
  • Silver harms you fully.
  • A moonstone carving that Selûne's priests give to the cursed who fight their curse.

Monsters & Treasure, Secrets: one of a kind, never sold, placed by the GM. Study it in downtime (Study a Secret); no one can teach it.
